E9v2-1.claim: every run job finished with status ok inside the 3 GB cap, with no invariant failure (e9's E9-1)

E9v2-2.claim: per run, C27's counts equal the grid and the step sums with reset_s and finish_s do not exceed wall_s by more than 1e-6 s (e9's E9-2)

E9v2-3.claim: every Sublet run: certificate available and held in Theorem W's proven cases, the envelope holds, no projecting run aborts while S follows FB and T0g stays in bound form (Proposition P)

E9v2-4.claim: every run's instance equals E9's at the same point and alignment (instance hash), so E9's one-day LP bounds (copied) bound these instances

E9v2-5.claim: every split run equals the uninstrumented Sublet run of its point and alignment bit for bit (ALG, the components, the per-slot cost series, the policy report, the schedule hash)

E9v2-6.claim: per point: the loops per simulated hour of Sublet and A9 against real time and the act time per slow slot (informative)
